facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - permit and isolation certificate records incomplete for PR-9410

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on PR-9410 and ACC-9410 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 2 February 2024 a planned assurance activity of PR-9410 and ACC-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks not effective.
